name: Yuri ga Saita Umi
source:
A coming-of-age story about the summer, sea, and yuri!

A group of girls, including the protagonist, spend their days on an island playing in the sea and getting cozy on the beach.

[From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12187]Novel Game Collection[/url]]
translation:
关于夏天、大海和尤里的成长故事！

包括主角在内的一群女孩在一座小岛上度过了在海里玩耍、在海滩上享受舒适的日子。

[来自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12187]小说游戏合集[/url]]
